title: Citadel pushes SEC to classify open-source developers as unregistered stockbrokers – Uniswap fires back
summary: On Dec. 2, Citadel Securities filed a 13-page letter with the SEC arguing that decentralized protocols facilitating tokenized US equity trading already meet statutory definitions of exchanges and broker-dealers, and regulators should treat them accordingly. title: Venezuela’s Nobel Winner Will Go to Norway for Peace Prize, Official Says
summary: Venezuelan officials say María Corina Machado will be considered a fugitive if she goes to Oslo, laying bare the risks for the opposition leader.

title: How would the Netflix-Warner Bros. deal reshape Hollywood?
summary: It’s only been a day since Netflix announced an $82.7 billion deal to acquire Warner Bros., and the acquisition has already been described as sending Hollywood into “full-blown panic mode,” “possibly a death blow to theatrical filmmaking,” and maybe even “the end of Hollywood” itself.
